nodes.title: Note
widgets_values:
# 08 · MiniMax H3 — talking persona with YOUR voice track
**Use:** load the persona's canon views → load the voice track (TTS or a recording, padded to the clip length; speech
starting at ≈ 0.5 s) → write what she says in **prompt** and refer to the track as `<Audio 1>` → Run → `video/H3_talk_*.mp4`.

The track is **frozen in the latent**: the clip's audio is exactly your file (series 11: envelope r 0.99–1.00, 10 ms) and
the lips follow it (sync 0.42–0.46 vs 0.23 when H3 speaks itself). Without the lock (`ref_audios` only) H3 re-voices the
line and shifts it 0.1–0.25 s — not usable for dubbing.

**Voice realism:** clean TTS sounds studio-like — add room + band-limit + bar ambience before loading
(`tools/s11.py tts_de`: highpass 120, lowpass 9k, compressor, short echo, ambience at −11 dB).
**Mouth:** H3 articulates big; the default prompt asks for relaxed, subtle articulation. Use the clip **as is**.
Series 11b tested post-hoc passes, and the user picked the plain H3 clip by eye over every one of them:
- delaying the picture 0.22 s (better sync metric, but looks worse);
- MuseTalk 1.5 (calmer mouth, soft lower face);
- LatentSync 1.6 (copies H3's mouth; calm only on a frozen frame).

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| frames | 124 = 5 s (keep the track ≤ clip length) · 226 = 9 s |
| 2nd / 3rd reference | as 03R |
| steps / shift / Sage | 30 / 12 / on (quality recipe) |
Don't run H3 here while the agent runs one on port 8189 (62 GB RAM is shared).

**Measured:** RunPod 5090, 5 s: ≈ 350 s without Sage (series 11)

widgets_values:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] <Picture 1>, <Picture 2> and <Picture 3> show the same woman, Maren, from the front, three-quarter and profile: identity references for her face, freckles, mole and scar only — not for framing, outfit or background. Whole clip is 5 seconds. Live-action. Medium close-up of a fictional 29-year-old woman, Maren, sitting at a bar counter in warm tungsten light, a glass of beer in front of her.
Appearance lock: long wavy copper-red hair, dense natural freckles, a tiny dark mole below her left eye, a thin pale scar line at her left eyebrow, green eyes, mature adult face, minimal makeup, black blouse.
0s-0.5s: she smiles. At 0.5s she looks into the camera and says the line from <Audio 1> ("Ehrlich, das ist das beste Bier in ganz Berlin. Prost!") in a relaxed, casual way: natural, subtle articulation, lips relaxed, the mouth opens only slightly, no exaggerated mouth shapes, timing follows <Audio 1>. After the line she lifts the glass slightly. Camera static.
Audio: her voice is the only voice, quiet bar murmur and glass clink underneath, no music.
negative: extra people talking, subtitles, text, music, distorted mouth, extra teeth

nodes.title: Note
widgets_values:
### 1 · Models
- **official** `minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot`; turbo 8-step LoRA as a **strength knob**: 0 = off = best quality
  (30 steps, res_multistep, shift 12 — series 1 winner); 0.8 + 12 steps = faster with a small loss; 1.0 + 8 steps = fastest, softest hands
- **Eros Max** beta5 int8 (community finetune, already turbo) + VBVR Pro attn-only @0.25 → for anatomy official H3 smears;
  ≈ 30 % softer, drifts darker (use *keep first-frame light*)
- text encoder `qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq` (32 B → ~58 GB system RAM), video/audio VAEs
- **shift** (MiniMaxH3SigmaShift, audio 3): 8 = sharper; lower = softer, less darkening on Eros
- **SageAttention** (toggle, default on): 8-bit attention, ≈ 2× faster (9 s: 445 → 224 s), same motion and colour (series 1)

nodes.title: Note
widgets_values:
### 5 · Decode + finish
- **drop frame 0**: frame 0 is the input still itself (sharper, other colour) → visible pop
- **keep first-frame light**: ColorMatch mkl of every frame against the first frame — stops the slow darkening/warming drift
- **sound**: H3 audio through a volume stage; off = no audio track
- **smooth 48 fps**: FILM ×2 (core FrameInterpolate, ≈ 30 s per 9 s; beat RIFE 4.7/4.26 on fast hands in series 1); lazy switch, off = never runs
